title: Edible City Series
description: Four reference-linked architectural scenes translating city-scale photography into sugar and chocolate construction.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the skyline axis, dusk lighting, and edible-material realism. Images 02-04 preserve that architectural camera logic while rotating the district from cathedral to bridge, hotel, and transit hall.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-sugar-cathedral-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
